notes.title: I Live Under Your House IS BACK
notes.content:
[img][/img]  
[h1][b] I Live Under Your House Remake is Coming Soon![/b][/h1]  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2697030/I_Live_Under_Your_House_Renovation/?beta=0  

This isn't just a graphics update - this is a significantly improved version of the game in all aspects featuring:
- Completely reworked dialogues
- An additional act  
- Foreign language support  
- Preservation of the cult classic atmosphere  

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45126928/0b1ac1029dcaff57c30b5043c99d2a07b87938d0.gif[/img]  

Over these three years, I've collected hundreds of community feedback pieces and gained experience that allowed me to reveal the full potential of the ILUYH universe in new ways.

This version includes:  
• Brand new high-quality graphics  
• Enhanced dialogues and monologues  
• Strengthened psychological elements  

Thank you to everyone who has supported me all these years and shown interest in the world of I Live Under Your House.

Warning: The remake contains even more violent scenes and descriptions - for prepared audiences only.

notes.title: Become a monster, again!
notes.content:
Hello, monsters! It's me, SpoocleMacBoogle! 

I am happy to announce that I have made a [b]new point and click novella[/b] in which you will play as a monster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978016/d48332eebc2883a7d69dd523bfeae1056feba513.png[/img]

This time there will be [b]more interactivity[/b], [b]different choices[/b] in dialogs, a [b]combat system[/b], 
[b]more characters[/b] and [b]an epic ending[/b]! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978016/e83d055f210b50185ea35a739512e094f6df3715.gif[/img]

You will have to live the [b]entire life cycle[/b] of the monster!

All this in a short novel called "MY ADAPTATION IN(TO) HUMAN" which you can wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967860/MY_ADAPTATION_INTO_HUMAN/]here[/url]

notes.title: Help me awaken.
notes.content:
Time, if I only knew what it is. 
Here, underground, in pitch darkness, I lie outside of all time. 
Sometimes, however, I feel my numb body awaken from its liturgic slumber, each muscular coming into motion again, pushing me along these subterranean corridors. At these moments I look at the outgrowths at the tips of my limbs and by their length I realize that something has changed and that this change is for me a reflection of time. 
I glide once again through the long, winding tunnels of my dwelling. 
Demons lurking in the shadows between the folds of the earth, watching me, waiting for my failure. 
But not today, they won't have that pleasure, because I'm more agile than ever.
This energy comes to me from outside, fills me, dispels demons into dust.
Soon I will once again be forced to find sustenance for my body... 
and for the bodies of my children..
Soon I will be out again....

notes.title: PARANORMAL GIRLFRIEND announcement
notes.content:
Hello underground monsters! It's me SpoocleMacBoogle, I have good news, I made a new game.
It's not as dark as this game (I live under your house), but I think it has an interesting storyline and you might like it. 

This is again a visual novel, with elements of 3d enviroments exploration, but this time it is more anime-like and more in the "basic visual novels" style.  

If you don't like that, that's okay, after a short break I'll take up again with a rather dark story without  anime girls. 

But for now, if you like mystery, anime, and you like short stories I invite you to check out Paranormal Girlfriend. 

There are also some fun secret endings. The release date is February 27. 

PARANORMAL GIRLFRIEND steampage: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2285880/PARANORMAL_GIRLFRIEND/

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: DLC IS OUT!
notes.content:
Greetings creatures! 
Today I am pleased to announce the release of the DLC titled "It lives under the house".

This DLC contains a separate storyline in the world of "I live under your house".

The add-on includes about half an hour of gameplay.
This time the emphasis is more on exploration, feeling claustrophobic, and the DLC game is done mostly in 3D space unlike the original game.

You will have to go again to the dirty tunnels under the house and look at them from a different perspective. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978016/a4ab9f051ab33898fa23dcba1be3704d780f733c.gif[/img]

Some quality of life improvements have also been added. 

For example, you can now exit the game during 3D scenes.


Buying this DLC is a great way to support the author!
Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Some news about upcoming DLC
notes.content:
Just a little sneak peek of the upcoming DLC... It promises to be quite claustrophobic. 

The workflow is on schedule, with an approximate release date in early December. 
Also in the near future will be released album with soundtracks for those who want to somehow support me besides buying the game.

Thank you for your support. 


P.S. I love tunnels and am terrified of them at the same time. I hope you too...

notes.title: It lives under the house. DLC
notes.content:
Hi, I want to share with you the news about the future fate of this game. 

A DLC called "It Lives Under the House" is planned for next month. 

In this DLC you'll see the continuation of the story, get to know the new hero, the game will be more interactive and... You know I can't tell too much, but it will be about the same length as the main game. 
Also new achievements will be added. 

Work on the main game as well as fixing bugs continues, feel free to write about any bugs you found, I try to fix them as soon as possible.

Thank you for supporting this project.

notes.title: Maintenance completed
notes.content:
I finally beat this bug! 
You no longer need to restart the game after getting the ending! (I've heard that somewhere before).
I really hope I fixed this bug once and for all. I'm just updating the game little by little, making changes and working on new content, so bugs may come back and new ones may appear, but I'm trying to fix them as soon as possible, hope for your understanding, thanks.

notes.title: Sorry for the technical difficulties! Fix coming soon!
notes.content: The last update broke the game, I am aware of this problem. So far, it is again required to restart the game after the first playthrough.  I will try to fix this in the next 4 hours! Sorry again for the inconvenience!
